Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
Champion's Quarter Station
---------------------------------
The CMT was designed to quickly whisk you across the capital with ease.  Simply select your destination to travel there.

[$imp]Archons' Quarter[$/imp] - Located at the far south end of the Citadel, the Archons' Quarter is dedicated to spiritual and political pursuits.  This Quarter is home to the Citadel Temple and is the seat of Government for the Tribes.

[$imp]Shamans' Quarter[$/imp] - Just north of the Archons' Quarter, the Shamans' Quarter is home to most of The Citadel's industry and shopping.

[$imp]Avenger's Quarter[$/imp] - Nestled between the Shamans' Quarter and the Champions' Quarter, the Avenger's Quarter is home to the local OCD Arena Combat chapter as well as several high performance shops.

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
--------------------------------
[$imp]Access Denied.[$/imp]

You do not currently possess a [$imp]Citadel Transit Pass[$/imp].  You must have  a Citadel Transit Pass in your inventory in order to use the Mass Transit System.  Would you like to purchase one now?

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
---------------------------------
The Avengers' Quarter (Also called 'the Hive District')

The Avengers' Quarter is home to the Insect tribe in the Citadel.  

On the [$loc]West side[$/loc] you will find:
[$imp]The Citadel Item Shop[$/imp] - The shopping spot for consumable items such as Blood Phials or Speed boosts.
[$imp]The Body Shop[$/imp] - Vehicle customization at it's best.
[$loc]The Grand Mall[$/loc] - The Avenger sponsored memorial and park.  Many of the great Avengers can be found here when they are in town.

On the [$loc]East Side[$/loc] you will find:
[$imp]OCD Registration[$/imp] - Arena combat signs up can be done here.


Which side of the Avengers' Quarter would you like to travel to?

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
---------------------------------
The Shamans' Quarter (Also called 'the Vine District')

The Shamans' Quarter is home to the Earth tribe in the Citadel.  

On the [$loc]West side[$/loc] you will find:
[$imp]The Refinery[$/imp] - Modelled after the Grand Refinery of Omphala, it is a sight to see!
[$imp]Citadel Salvage[$/imp] - 2nd hand 'fixer upper' gear for the industrious crafter.
[$imp]Control Shop[$/imp] - The first of many Control Shop installations built in the Shamans' Quarter.
[$loc]Jared's Park[$/loc] - Located on the lower west side, Jared's Park is a memorial built to honor fallen Shaman .

On the [$loc]East Side[$/loc] you will find:
[$imp]The Reactor[$/imp] - The first Montaine-style Reactor built in the Citadel is located on the East Side of the Shaman's Quarter.
[$imp]Curiosity Shop[$/imp] - A store that caters to crafters and warriors looking for tools to repair their broken gear, odd knick-knacks or books.
[$imp]Citadel Iron Works[$/imp] - The Citadel's largest and best supplier of Powerplants and Armor.
[$imp]Fabrication Plant[$/imp] - The Fabrication plant located on the east side was actually built in the time of Marion, supposedly by Jared himself.

Which side of the Shamans' Quarter would you like to travel to?

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
---------------------------------
The Champions' Quarter

The Champions' Quarter is home to the Bear tribe in the Citadel.  

From the [$loc]Central Station[$/loc] you can walk to:
[$imp]The Clan Registrar[$/imp] - You can register your cadre of Warriors with the Clan Registrar, west of the central station.
[$imp]Citadel Arms[$/imp] - Vehicle mounted weapons of all types can be found here, west of the central station.  Many of the Citadel's best Champions can be found here arguing the fine points of tactics and weaponry.

On the [$loc]East Side[$/loc] you will find:
[$imp]Citadel Vehicles[$/imp] - If you are looking to purchase a new vehicle, you'll want to stop here, located next door to the East Side station.

Which side of the Champions' Quarter would you like to travel to?

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
---------------------------------
The Archons' Quarter (Also called the 'Spirit District')

The Archons' Quarter is home to the Spirit tribe in the Citadel and is the central seat of Government for the Tribes.  

In the Archons' Quarter you will find:
[$loc]The Council Chamber[$/loc] - The Ruling Council meets here, beneath the Dome of Blessed Brass, to decide the future of the Tribes.
[$loc]Citadel Temple[$/loc] - The first Temple, founded by Marion and built by Jared is an icon unto itself.  Many pilgrims come to the Citadel to look upon the Spirit Flames and to hear a sermon from the Prime Archon of the Tribes.
[$loc]The Walk of Heroes[$/loc] - Located on the lower level of the Archons' Quarter, the Walk of Heroes is dedicated to fallen Archons and is the home to the Tomb, the final resting place of The Voice.
[$imp]The Locus Exchange[$/imp] - This small store, located next door to the station, will buy your wraith Locus or sell you a newer, more powerful one, for a price.

Would you like to travel to the Archons' Quarter, now?

Citadel Mass Transit (CMT)
---------------------------------
Welcome to the Citadel Mass Transit system!  Built in the 5th generation, the Citadel Mass Transit system was designed to quickly and safely whisk you across the city to your destination.  The Citadel is divided into four districts:

[$imp]The Champions' Quarter[$/imp] - As the home of the Bear Tribe in the Citadel, many of the Tribes' greatest Champions can be found here.  The Champions' Quarter is also where the weapon and vehicle stores are found.

[$imp]The Avengers' Quarter[$/imp] - The home of the Insect Tribe is also  home to many of the vehicle customization shops here in the Citadel.

[$imp]The Shamans' Quarter[$/imp] - The industrial district of the Citadel, the Shamans' Quarter is home to the Earth Tribe, and many of the Citadel's crafting stores and installations.

[$imp]The Archons' Quarter[$/imp] - The spiritual and political center of the Tribes, the Archons' Quarter is home to many memorials and sacred sites as well as the seat of government for the Tribes.

Which quarter of the Citadel would you like to travel to?
